resources.string: Trial is OFF. Enable it in settings on both PC and phone.
Detection is not yet verified in this environment.

Same Wi-Fi pairing is required. Enable the trial in the Windows widget menu as well. Read-only local logs can detect new turn start, completion and interruption after observation begins. Approval/input waits, turn failure and mobile Remote detection remain unverified; they are not inferred. Turn completion is not project completion. This screen checks status every 15 seconds while open; background sharing follows the existing best-effort schedule. Widgets show the last contact time. Losing contact does not mean the work failed. Turn OFF on both devices to stop observation and transmission.
